sections.text:
Increases Ability Power of physical and magic attacks inflicted on all enemies by 12 for 60 seconds.
Added effect: Reduces the action speed (Cost recovery speed) of all enemies for 60 seconds and increases the magic healing effect of all Cleric-Class allies by 30% for 60 seconds.
Level bonus: Ability Power increase boosted by 2 for each increase in Skill level.
